capabilities: insert the currently playing song or podcast at the cursor position
render inserted tracks through a custom user template
fetch all tracks played since the beginning of the current day
disambiguation: Not a Spotify playback controller; it only inserts text about the currently playing track into notes.
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally. Known issues: the Web viewer core plugin can break the Spotify login (workaround opens the system browser with a copy-link/paste-redirect fallback), and Spotify's February 2026 restriction of Development Mode apps makes a Premium subscription required and leaves some template variables deprecated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record what you are listening to on Spotify while writing notes.

relations.evidence: Users can connect their Spotify accounts using the official Spotify API.

requires.name: Spotify Premium subscription for the app owner

summary: Spotify integration that inserts the currently playing song or podcast at the cursor and fetches the day's played-track history.
